svg.title: Sequence Diagram — Book Appointment
svg.desc: Lecturer-style UML Sequence Diagram with 6 lifelines and 34 numbered main-success interactions.

text.tspan: 3. Load PUBLISHED release and frozen booking terms
4. Release terms and current capacity state
7. Display arrival window and governing booking terms
10. Atomically revalidate group and acquire one ACTIVE
11. Hold acquired: selected group and expiry context
12. Show protected group and hold countdown
14. Start full payment for active hold
15. Load hold snapshot and enforce one non-terminal
25. Verify payment through trusted gateway channel
28. Payment persisted and booking target eligible
33. Return confirmed Appointment and payment status
34. Display confirmation, receipt summary and arrival
